plainText:
Tasuku Hatanaka (Japanese: 畠中 祐 Tasuku Hatanaka) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hatanaka was born on August 17, 1994, in , . He started work on the with , where he voiced Jacq. Hatanaka would gain additional roles including Roy's Kilowattrel and . He is married to fellow voice actor Sayaka Senbongi.
